fields.label: Project Name
fields.value: THE ICON NORTH Towers A and B

fields.label: Project Description
fields.value: G CORP Buildwell Pvt Ltd is a subsidiary company under GCORP group. As GCORP group, company has executed few Projects in Bangalore and other cities. In the last 5 years, the Project ICON-North, a group housing residential apartment project situated at Thanisandra Main road, Bangalore North has been developed in phases. The Project is developed on the land spread over 19 acres and consisting of 12 towers with 1131 apartments. Out of which, 2 towers ( 158 apartments) Towers A and B has been completed , Occupancy certifiate recieved , handed over and occupied. Hence , for this submission, considered as completion.

fields.label: Project Description
fields.value: G CORP MAHALAKSHMI is a boutique apartments located at Sahakarnagar Bengaluru and having a site area of about 8360 sqm out of which 6620 sqmt is under development for this Project . The project consists of 2 blocks namely Block A with Ground plus 4 floors and Block B with Ground plus 4 floors comprising of 3 and 4 bhk apartments contributing to 67 number of apartments. Project has exclusive health club gym and a mini pool. The project is environmental friendly and IGBC pre certified gold. The Project is developed in joint development with the land owners
